items.source: Create a container-managed extended EntityManager proxy.
items.translation: 创建托管的扩展 EntityManager 代理。

items.source: Create an application-managed extended EntityManager proxy.
items.translation: 创建由应用程序管理的扩展 EntityManager 代理。

items.source: emfInfo - the EntityManagerFactoryInfo to obtain the JpaDialect and PersistenceUnitInfo from
items.translation: emfInfo - 用于获取 JpaDialect 和 PersistenceUnitInfo 的 EntityManagerFactoryInfo

items.source: emf - the EntityManagerFactory to create the EntityManager with. If this implements the EntityManagerFactoryInfo interface, the corresponding JpaDialect and PersistenceUnitInfo will be detected accordingly.
items.translation: `emf` - 用于创建 EntityManager 的 EntityManagerFactory。如果该对象实现了 EntityManagerFactoryInfo 接口，将相应地检测出对应的 JpaDialect 和 PersistenceUnitInfo。

items.source:
a container-managed EntityManager that will automatically participate
in any managed transaction
items.translation: 一个容器管理的 EntityManager，将自动参与任何托管事务。

items.source:
an application-managed EntityManager that can join transactions
but does not participate in them automatically
items.translation: 一个由应用程序管理的 EntityManager，它可以加入事务，但不会自动参与事务。

items.source: Supports several variants of "extended" EntityManagers: in particular, an "application-managed extended EntityManager", as defined by EntityManagerFactory.createEntityManager(), as well as a "container-managed extended EntityManager", as defined by PersistenceContextType.EXTENDED.
items.translation: 支持多种“扩展”EntityManager 变体：特别是由 `EntityManagerFactory.createEntityManager()` 定义的“应用程序管理的扩展 EntityManager"，以及由 `PersistenceContextType.EXTENDED` 定义的“容器管理的扩展 EntityManager"。

items.source: The original difference between "application-managed" and "container-managed" was the need for explicit joining of an externally managed transaction through the EntityManager.joinTransaction() method in the "application" case versus the automatic joining on each user-level EntityManager operation in the "container" case. As of JPA 2.1, both join modes are available with both kinds of EntityManagers, so the difference between "application-" and "container-managed" is now primarily in the join mode default and in the restricted lifecycle of a container-managed EntityManager (i.e. tied to the object that it is injected into).
items.translation: “应用管理”与“容器管理”之间的原始区别在于：在“应用”情况下，需要通过 `EntityManager.joinTransaction()` 方法显式加入外部管理的事务，而在“容器”情况下，则是在每个用户级 EntityManager 操作上自动加入。自 JPA 2.1 起，两种连接模式均可用于这两种类型的 EntityManager，因此“应用管理”与“容器管理”之间的区别现在主要在于连接模式的默认值以及容器管理的 EntityManager 的生命周期受限（即与其被注入的对象绑定）。

items.source: properties - the properties to be passed into the createEntityManager call (may be null)
items.translation: properties - 要传递给 createEntityManager 调用的属性（可为 null）

items.source: synchronizedWithTransaction - whether to automatically join ongoing transactions (according to the JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType rules)
items.translation: synchronizedWithTransaction - 是否根据 JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType 规则自动加入正在进行的交易。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rod Johnson, Mark Paluch
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rod Johnson, Mark Paluch

items.source:
a container-managed EntityManager that expects container-driven lifecycle
management but may opt out of automatic transaction synchronization
items.translation: 由容器管理的 EntityManager，期望由容器驱动生命周期管理，但可以选择退出自动事务同步。
